rendered:
The NiTi wires were strained axially in tension to 5%[1] and 10%[2] substrate strain. Because of the shape-memory property of the NiTi alloy, these applied strains were maintained after unloading, which placed the surface V2O5 film under locked-in mechanical strain. The overall range explored was 0−10%[3] axial tensile strain.
Source: the applied strains (5%[4] and 10%[5]) were maintained after unloading by placing the surface V2O5 film under varying mechanical strains.
